messages:
deploybot: Heads-up: rollout scheduled for 23:00 UTC. Change window open 22:45-00:30 UTC. Pinning stable -> v4.0.1 for this release. Stagger plan: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 3m holds.

maria: Thanks. Who owns canary and smoke? Need someone at T+1m and T+5m.

owen: I can take canary and smoke. Will post quick pass/fail.

sre_oncall: I'll be on watch from 22:40-00:40. Alert trigger: error rate >= 2% OR p95 > 1000ms for 2 consecutive mins.

kevin_ops: Rollback checklist uploaded: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-v4.0.1. Quick command if emergency: `redwood pin set stable v3.9.8 --reason "emergency rollback"` and run `scripts/rollback-configs.sh`.

product_andy: Release notes: embedding cache TTL change + batching improvements. No model schema migration. RN posted: /docs/releases/v4.0.1.md

maria: Deploybot, confirm autoscaler warmup and any scheduled cache flushes.

deploybot: autoscaler: +40% capacity pre-warm from 22:30 UTC. kv-cache: no scheduled flush. Canary traffic slice = 1%.

maria: Smoke checklist for canary (keep it short):
- run smoke/generate_smoke.sh --canary --count 8
- verify embeddings latency < 350ms
- confirm kv cache hit > 65%
- hit /healthz and check status==ok

owen: Added a DB read-only check and feature-flag sanity. I'll paste results after push.

product_andy: Policy: any customer-facing regressions -> abort rollout and notify #incidents immediately. No silent changes.

kevin_ops: I've also staged a config revert: `configstore set quant_profile previous || true` in rollback script. Ops ready.

deploybot: starting deployment at 22:58:30 UTC -> pushing v4.0.1 to stable-slot (canary 1%).

nowen: Canary live. Quick run: gen p95 320ms, embeddings p95 290ms, 8/8 smoke passes. kv-cache-hit 68%. All green.

sre_oncall: Watching metrics: error rate 0.3%, p95 340ms. No anomalous spikes.

maria: Hold 3m then ramp to 10%. Owen, keep an eye on customer beta orgs.

deploybot: ramping to 10% at 23:03:45 UTC.

nowen: After 10% ramp: smoke 20/20 success, embeddings p95 310ms, errors 0.5%. No stderr exceptions.

product_andy: Quick sanity on critical checkout flow in staging mirror: passes.

maria: Proceed to 50% after 5m if stable. Reminder: quiet window until 00:30 UTC, no other deploys.

sre_oncall: If anything crosses threshold during ramp, I'll call for immediate traffic shift back to v3.9.8. Kevin, are you prepared to execute?

kevin_ops: Affirmative. I have unpin rights and will execute `redwood pin set stable v3.9.8 --reason "sre rollback"` plus config revert. Standby 5m.

deploybot: ramp to 50% at 23:10:10 UTC.

nowen: Post-50% metrics: p95 generation 360ms, embeddings 340ms, errors 0.7%. KV hit 66%. Still within thresholds.

maria: Okay, final 100% ramp in 4m if no alerts. Owen, post final smoke completion.

product_andy: I'll prepare the short release blurb for marketing and engineers.

sre_oncall: No sustained anomalies. Monitoring until 00:40.

deploybot: final rollout -> 100% at 23:16:05 UTC. Pin stable remains v4.0.1.

nowen: Final smoke completed: 50/50 end-to-end checks passed. Uploading logs to /artifacts/3421004321/smoke.log.

kevin_ops: Rollback not required. Closing standby. I'll archive rollback temp branch.

maria: Nice work. Post-deploy tasks: 1) drop 2-line note in #releases, 2) attach smoke logs, 3) watch alerts for 24h. I'll kick off a short postmortem if anything crops up.

product_andy: RN live and shared with growth. Cheers. :tada:

deploybot: deployment summary: v4.0.1 -> stable, started 22:58:30 UTC, completed 23:16:05 UTC, no rollbacks.
